goals: Universally give every BGE-bound physical state the active Iris shader material classification of its authoritative BGE-projected canonical state when that canonical state is mapped, without altering the shader pack.
Use BGE C79's authoritative BgeMaterialBindings and state projection rather than BGE registry-name parsing or a derived-block inventory.
Preserve shader-pack authority: an explicit physical BGE material or layer assignment wins over parent inheritance.
scope: Provide a client-only Fabric bridge for exact BGE C79 and Iris 1.11.2+mc26.2 that augments completed Iris material and layer maps at their narrow RETURN seams.

Canary 2 applies the same universal authoritative canonical-parent rule to every BgeMaterialBindings binding, preserving BGE's state-specific canonical projection for material IDs and using the binding's canonical block for Iris layer.* entries.
Retain Translucent Glass and BGE × CTM as adjacent diagnostic context only; this project does not own their rendering or Continuity behavior.

exclusions: Do not modify, copy into the artifact, redistribute, or patch the Complementary archive, originals/, Iris JAR, or saved shader configuration.
Do not modify BGE core or BGE × CTM; BGE retains canonical binding/state projection and native render setup, while BGE × CTM retains Continuity behavior.

No hard-coded Complementary material IDs, BGE-derived registry-name parsing, generated per-derived-block ID table, shader-pack parser replacement, material-category allowlist or denylist, or override of an explicit shader-pack physical mapping.

dependencies.reason: Exact current BGE C79 provides the authoritative BgeMaterialBindings and canonical state projection consumed by this version-coupled bridge.
BGE × CTM remains adjacent Continuity context and is not an implementation dependency for Iris material inheritance.
The private bridge targets Iris BlockMaterialMapping's exact completed-map descriptors and fail-closes for every other Iris version or Iris absence.
Exact read-only shader-pack audit target for material and layer behavior.
Useful clear-glass texture and CTM diagnostic only; it is not a shader-material provider.

Tracked Workbench Gradle wrapper baseline used for Canary 1.

state.milestone: Canary 2 is an ACTIVE client-only BGE C79/Iris 1.11.2 bridge. For every authoritative BgeMaterialBindings physical state it augments Iris's completed state material map only when that BGE-projected canonical state is mapped; its block-wide layer fallback follows the same canonical-parent rule. Explicit physical pack entries always win. The exact retained artifact passed clean static validation and awaits owner-directed in-game testing.

regression_evidence: Clean Canary 2 verification hashes the retained BGE C79 JAR as 7e3265c8746547465ede1a48b31c3db06370de84331b8ff9e35a2ce450650a91, requires BgeMaterialBindings.class, and runs focused universal-inheritance coverage.

regression_evidence: Static audit records the exact BlockMaterialMapping material and layer RETURN descriptors, and focused tests prove universal completed-map fallback precedence without hard-coded shader IDs or a parent-category policy.

current.summary: Universally inherits active Iris canonical shader material and layer classifications for every authoritative BGE C79 binding.
